section_full_title: Disobedience of orders, obstruction and refusal of information
description: Jumping red lights, ignoring traffic signals, disobeying police hand signals or road markings
notes: Enforced via AI cameras and patrol; challan issued on the spot or via e-challan

section_full_title: Regulation of traffic by traffic signs
description: Failing to follow directional signs, lane discipline signs, or mandatory road signs
notes: Includes wrong-way driving, ignoring no-entry signs

section_full_title: Parking in prohibited area
description: Stopping or parking in no-parking zones, bus stops, pedestrian crossings, or yellow-line areas
notes: Higher fines in metro areas; vehicle may be towed at owner's cost

section_full_title: General provision for punishment of offences
description: Any traffic violation not specifically covered under another section — general catch-all provision
notes: First offence Rs.500; subsequent offence Rs.1500

section_full_title: Penalty for travelling without pass or ticket
description: Conductor or driver allowing passengers to travel without valid ticket in stage carriage
notes: Applicable to TNSTC, MTC, and private buses in Tamil Nadu

section_full_title: Disobedience to authority
description: Refusing to stop vehicle when directed by a police officer or traffic authority
notes: Includes refusal to provide documents when demanded by authority

section_full_title: Allowing unauthorised persons to drive vehicles
description: Permitting a person without a valid licence to drive your vehicle
notes: Owner of vehicle held liable

section_full_title: Necessity for driving licence
description: No person shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place without a valid driving licence
notes: Foundational provision; violation penalised under Section 181

section_full_title: Driving without licence
description: Driving or riding a motor vehicle in a public place without holding a valid driving licence
notes: Revised from Rs.500 to Rs.5000 in MV Amendment 2019; licence confiscation also possible

section_full_title: Driving despite disqualification
description: Driving a vehicle when the licence has been suspended, revoked, or disqualified by court or authority
notes: Repeat offence: up to 2 years imprisonment

section_full_title: Vehicle not complying with standards
description: Driving or selling a vehicle that does not conform to safety or emission standards prescribed by the government
notes: Includes altered vehicles; applies to manufacturers, dealers, and owners

section_full_title: Offences by juveniles — guardian and owner liability
description: Motor vehicle offence committed by a person under 18 years; guardian and vehicle owner held liable
notes: Vehicle registration cancelled; minor tried under Juvenile Justice Act

section_full_title: Necessity for registration
description: No person shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place unless the vehicle is registered under the Act
notes: Registration must be renewed after validity; penalty under Section 192

section_full_title: Using vehicle without registration
description: Driving or causing to drive an unregistered motor vehicle on a public road
notes: First offence Rs.2000–5000; repeat offence includes imprisonment

section_full_title: Using vehicle without permit
description: Using a transport vehicle (goods/passenger) without a valid permit on a public road
notes: Permit must match route, purpose, and category of vehicle

section_full_title: Power to impound documents
description: Police officer can seize driving licence, RC book, insurance, or permit when violation is detected
notes: Documents held pending appearance before licensing authority or court
chatbot_keywords: insurance,third party,uninsured; licence,license,DL,driving licence,no licence; RC,registration,unregistered vehicle

section_full_title: Necessity for insurance against third-party risk
description: Every motor vehicle used in a public place must have a valid third-party insurance policy
notes: Violation penalised under Section 196; foundational insurance requirement

section_full_title: Using vehicle without insurance
description: Driving or allowing to drive a motor vehicle without a valid third-party insurance certificate
notes: Revised from Rs.1000 to Rs.2000 in 2019; repeat offence: Rs.4000 or 3 months

section_full_title: Driving at excessive speed
description: Driving a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the maximum speed limit prescribed for that road or vehicle type
notes: LMV: Rs.1000; MMV: Rs.2000; expressway violations higher; repeat offence licence suspension

section_full_title: Driving dangerously / using mobile phone while driving
description: Rash or dangerous driving; using handheld mobile phone while driving; any act endangering public safety
notes: Mobile phone: Rs.1000 first offence, Rs.10000 repeat; dangerous driving: up to Rs.5000

section_full_title: Driving under influence of alcohol or drugs
description: Driving with blood alcohol content exceeding 30mg per 100ml of blood, or under influence of drugs
notes: Breath analyser test; licence suspended on conviction; Rs.10000 first, Rs.15000 repeat

section_full_title: Driving when mentally or physically unfit
description: Driving a vehicle when the driver knows they are suffering from a disease or disability making driving dangerous
notes: Includes driving when fatigued, ill, or on sedative medication

section_full_title: Racing and trials of speed on public roads
description: Organising, participating in, or promoting illegal vehicle racing or speed competitions on public roads
notes: Rs.5000 and/or 1 month first offence; Rs.10000 and/or 1 year repeat
chatbot_keywords: racing,speed trial,drag race; speed,overspeeding,fast driving,speed limit

section_full_title: Safety measures for drivers and pillion riders
description: Triple riding on two-wheelers; pillion rider not seated properly; child below 4 years without safety harness
notes: Child safety harness mandatory for children below 4 years; amended 2019

section_full_title: Wearing of protective headgear (helmet)
description: Driver or pillion rider on a two-wheeler not wearing a helmet conforming to BIS standards
notes: Helmet must be ISI-marked; licence may be suspended for 3 months on repeat violation

section_full_title: Seat belt
description: Driver or any occupant of a motor vehicle travelling without wearing a seat belt as prescribed
notes: Applicable to all seats including rear; strictly enforced post-2019

section_full_title: Use of handheld communication device while driving
description: Using a mobile phone or any handheld communication device while operating a motor vehicle
notes: First offence Rs.1000; repeat Rs.5000–10000; hands-free devices permitted

section_full_title: Wearing of seat belt — penalty provision
description: Specific penalty provision for seat belt violation; supplements Section 194B
notes: Companion provision to 194B; same fine structure

section_full_title: Not giving way to emergency vehicles
description: Failing to give way to ambulance, fire brigade, police, or other emergency vehicles on duty
notes: New section under MV Amendment 2019; strictly enforced

section_full_title: Taking vehicle without authority
description: Taking a motor vehicle without the owner's consent; joy-riding with another's vehicle
notes: Separate from theft; vehicle taken temporarily without consent

section_full_title: Using vehicle in unsafe condition / no PUC certificate
description: Using a vehicle without a valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate; defective brakes, lights, horn, tyres, or mirrors
notes: No PUC: up to Rs.10000; defective parts: Rs.500–1000 per item; vehicle may be impounded

section_full_title: Use of vehicle emitting excessive smoke or noise
description: Operating a vehicle that emits smoke, fumes, or noise beyond prescribed standards
notes: PUC certificate must be renewed every 6 months for old vehicles, yearly for new

section_full_title: No reflectors or inadequate lighting
description: Driving without prescribed headlights, tail lights, indicators, or reflectors at night
notes: Enforced under general penalty provision; especially for slow-moving and goods vehicles

section_full_title: Vehicle not meeting safety and emission standards
description: Driving or selling a vehicle that does not comply with prescribed safety or emission standards
notes: Covers illegally modified vehicles, removed catalytic converters, altered silencers

section_full_title: Driving vehicle exceeding permissible weight
description: Goods vehicle carrying load exceeding the registered gross vehicle weight or axle load
notes: Rs.2000 per excess tonne; maximum Rs.20000; offending vehicle detained until excess load removed

section_full_title: Overloading of passengers
description: Carrying passengers beyond the seating or standing capacity specified in the vehicle permit
notes: Fine per extra passenger; conductor and driver both liable

section_full_title: Duty of driver to stop and report accident
description: Driver involved in an accident must stop the vehicle, render assistance to injured, and report to nearest police
notes: Failure to stop or report is a criminal offence; Good Samaritan law protects bystanders who help

section_full_title: Duty of owner of motor vehicle — accident compensation
description: Owner must provide all required information to police and third-party claimants following an accident
notes: Enables insurance claims; owner must not tamper with evidence

section_full_title: Hit and run compensation scheme
description: Victims of hit-and-run accidents (driver unknown) entitled to compensation from Solatium Fund
notes: Death: Rs.2,00,000; Grievous hurt: Rs.50,000; claim filed with police or insurance authority

section_full_title: Causing death by negligence
description: Causing death of a person by rash or negligent driving not amounting to culpable homicide
notes: Most common IPC charge in fatal road accidents; often combined with MV Act sections

section_full_title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
description: Driving rashly or negligently on a public road endangering human life or causing hurt or injury
notes: Charged alongside MV Act Section 184; up to Rs.1000 fine or imprisonment or both

section_full_title: Causing hurt by act endangering life
description: Causing hurt (minor injury) to another person due to rash or negligent act including driving
notes: Applied in non-fatal injury road accidents

section_full_title: Causing grievous hurt by act endangering life
description: Causing grievous hurt (serious injury) to another person due to rash or negligent driving
notes: Applied in serious injury accidents; grievous hurt includes fractures, permanent disability

section_full_title: Control of building, fences etc. near National Highway
description: No construction, fence, tree planting, or obstruction within 20m of NH boundary without permission
notes: NHAI enforces; violations require demolition at owner's cost

section_full_title: Protection of State Highways
description: Prohibition on encroachment, damage, or unauthorised construction along State Highways in Tamil Nadu
notes: Enforced by Highways Department, Tamil Nadu; covers all state highways

section_full_title: Penalty for damaging or obstructing public roads
description: Digging, breaking, or obstructing any public road within municipal limits without authorisation
notes: Municipality issues stop-work notice; restoration at violator's cost

section_full_title: Speed limits in urban / city areas
description: Maximum permissible speed in city and urban areas: LMV 50 kmph; two-wheelers 40 kmph; buses/trucks 40 kmph
notes: Speed limit signs mandatory; AI cameras deployed in Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy

section_full_title: Speed limits on State and National Highways
description: Cars/LMV: 100 kmph; LCV: 80 kmph; Buses: 80 kmph; Trucks/HMV: 60 kmph; Two-wheelers: 80 kmph
notes: Expressways (Chennai-Bangalore, Chennai Bypass): higher limits with variable messaging signs

section_full_title: Speed limits near schools and hospitals
description: Maximum 25 kmph within 100 metres of school buildings; 30 kmph near hospitals
notes: Speed breakers mandatory; school zone marking required; double fine provision applies
chatbot_keywords: school zone,school area,children; speed,overspeeding,fast driving,speed limit

section_full_title: Night driving restrictions for heavy vehicles
description: Heavy motor vehicles restricted from operating in Chennai city limits between 09:00 AM and 10:00 PM on weekdays
notes: Tamil Nadu government order for congestion management; exemptions for essential goods

section_full_title: Protection of Good Samaritans
description: Any person rendering emergency assistance to road accident victim shall not be liable for any civil or criminal action
notes: Supreme Court guidelines implemented; Good Samaritan cannot be detained by police or hospital
chatbot_keywords: ambulance,emergency vehicle,fire brigade; accident,crash,collision,hit and run,fatality

section_full_title: Enhanced penalty for offences committed in certain areas or conditions
description: Double the original fine if offence is committed in school zone, hospital zone, or while under influence of alcohol/drugs
notes: Multiplier clause; base fine doubled automatically; applies over applicable section

section_full_title: Penalty for abetment of offences
description: Any person who aids, abets, or induces another to commit a motor vehicle offence is liable equally
notes: Applies to fleet owners, managers, and dispatchers who encourage violations

section_full_title: Necessity for permit for transport vehicles
description: No transport vehicle (taxi, auto, bus, goods lorry) shall be used in a public place without a valid permit
notes: Permits: Stage Carriage, Contract Carriage, Goods Carriage; issued by RTA Tamil Nadu

section_full_title: Using vehicle without permit
description: Operating a transport vehicle without valid permit, or on route/purpose not covered by permit
notes: Vehicle seized; Rs.10000 fine; permit must match vehicle type, route, and load

section_full_title: Failure to surrender suspended or cancelled certificate of registration
description: Owner failing to surrender RC book when registration is suspended or cancelled by authority
notes: RC cancelled on court order or on scrapping of vehicle

section_full_title: Noise pollution limits for vehicles
description: Vehicle horn, exhaust, or engine noise must not exceed prescribed decibel limits (e.g. 80 dB for cars at 7.5m)
notes: CPCB and Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board enforce; modified silencers prohibited

section_full_title: Bharat Stage VI (BS6) emission norms compliance
description: All new vehicles sold after April 2020 must comply with BS6 emission standards; BS4 vehicles cannot be re-registered
notes: Tamil Nadu RTO enforces during registration; older non-compliant vehicles face deregistration

section_full_title: Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate requirement
description: Every vehicle must carry a valid PUC certificate obtained from authorised testing centre
notes: Renewal: 6 months for vehicles older than 15 years; yearly for others; checked at checkposts

act_name: Tamil Nadu Road Safety Act 2012 / MV Act
section_full_title: Failure to yield to pedestrians at zebra crossing
description: Vehicle driver must stop and give way to pedestrians using a marked pedestrian crossing or zebra crossing
notes: Enforced under general provisions; pedestrian right-of-way strictly enforced in Chennai since 2022

section_full_title: Speed and safety rules in school zones
description: Speed limit 25 kmph; no honking within 100m; stop for school buses; follow traffic warden instructions
notes: School zone signs mandatory; applies during school hours (7AM–9AM and 3PM–5PM)
chatbot_keywords: pedestrian,zebra crossing,footpath; school zone,school area,children; speed,overspeeding,fast driving,speed limit

section_full_title: Tamil Nadu enhanced traffic enforcement — December 2024
description: Revised fines effective 1 December 2024; strict enforcement via AI cameras in 20+ cities; e-challan mandatory
notes: GO issued by Transport Department TN; covers helmet, signal, overspeeding, mobile use

section_full_title: Heavy vehicle movement restrictions in Chennai
description: Trucks and HMV restricted from Chennai city roads between 9:00 AM and 10:00 PM on weekdays
notes: Exemptions: hospital supplies, emergency goods; enforced at city entry checkpoints

section_full_title: Auto-rickshaw meter and route rules
description: Auto-rickshaws must use calibrated meters; refusing fare or taking wrong routes punishable
notes: RTO and police jointly enforce; complaints via TN police app or 100
